summary: Iteration 80 — Comprehensive frontend audit on blue@blue.com (fresh demo, free tier, 15 active items incl. 1 set). All 13 review-request criteria PASS via runtime DOM + testID probes through the public preview URL. Authenticated by POSTing /api/auth/login and seeding localStorage('tt.auth.token' + 'tt.auth.user') — direct UI login was bypassed per iter78/79 guidance. (1) Dashboard renders: tbv-header / home-details-box / home-dealers-widget / feedback-banner all present; no 'Free plan item limit reached - N Hidden tools' banner appears on the demo account, confirming the new item-count rule (tools+sets, excluding sold/lost) lands exactly at the 15-item free cap with 0 hidden. (2) Bottom-tab nav: /inventory, /claims, /dealers, /borrowers, /more, /reports all route + render without crash. (3) Inventory: 10+ tool-card-{id} rows render (15 in API), search-input and inv-filters-btn present, filters modal opens (filters-close available). (4) Tool detail: tabs tab-details, tab-photos, tab-documents, tab-maintenance, tab-warranty, tab-history all visible. (5) Set/Bundle (Master Socket Set, 3ac0dc67…): tab-bundle present and clickable on /tool/{set_id}. (6) Claims tab: OPEN / DEALERS / HISTORY headings render as static panels (claims-search testID present). (7) Insurance Claims: ic-tab-summary/open/closed/archived, ic-stat-* (Total/Open/Closed/Denied/Tasks/Archived/Claimed/Approved/Paid), ic-new-fab all render. (8) Dealers: 5+ dealer-card-{id} rows render with dealer-row-call / dealer-row-text actions; clicking a card opens /dealer/{id} which loads without errors. (9) Borrowers: 3+ borrower-row-{id} rows render; clicking opens /borrower/{id} without errors. (10) Vault (More): 9 SectionCards render (roadmap, system, organization, import-export aka DATA MANAGEMENT, insurance, notifications, theme, customize, account); more-remove-preloaded row appears for blue@blue.com (demo present). Tapping more-remove-preloaded opens prefilled-choice modal with prefilled-keep ('Keep My Setup — Remove demo tools, claims & contacts — keep dealers, locations, tags & categories') and prefilled-everything ('Remove Everything — Wipe all sample data including dealers, locations, tags & categories — start blank') and CANCEL button — verified by screenshot. (11) Data Management screen (/data-management): INSTALL PRELOADED DATA + REMOVE DATA sections present (dm-install-btn + dm-remove-btn both render); the old 'PREFILLED INFORMATION' text, 'Delete the preloaded data instead' link, dm-delete-prefilled testID, and dm-demo-choice testID are all GONE. (12) Theme switching in /more works: theme-family-plain expands to appearance-light/appearance-dark, theme-family-iron expands to appearance-industrial / industrial-pink / industrial-arctic / industrial-emerald — switching between them re-renders without crashing (more-section-theme stays mounted; no pageerror). (13) Reports: /reports loads with 'Report' / 'Inventory' / 'Insurance' text present (didn't fully generate a PDF per request). Zero JS pageerrors throughout the run. No deprecated Expo packages (expo-av/barcode-scanner/background-fetch) introduced in the changed files.
action_items: (Low priority cleanup) Metro bundler error log spam: '/var/log/supervisor/expo.out.log' emits 'Metro error: ENOENT: no such file or directory, open /app/frontend/app/tbv-kit.tsx' repeatedly during error-bundle SSR. No source file or import references tbv-kit anywhere in /app/frontend/app or /app/frontend/src (verified via grep). The stale reference appears to be either (a) a generated route in .expo/types/router.d.ts (regenerates from existing files but keeps an entry once seen) or (b) a baked-in path inside the bundled error-fallback chunk under .expo/static-tmp/_error.js. Functionally HARMLESS — the SSR HTML still serves correctly and the live app loads + navigates without error — but the noise pollutes the logs and produces transient 500s on the error-bundle URL. Suggested fix: rm -rf /app/frontend/.expo /app/frontend/.metro-cache && sudo supervisorctl restart expo, OR find which dev-only route emitter still lists tbv-kit (perhaps an upcoming-features registry, sitemap, or a stale require.context in an admin file). Note: I already cleared .metro-cache and .expo/types once; the error continued — suggesting the source is being re-generated at startup, so the underlying registration likely lives in a code file or dependency that still produces a /tbv-kit path even though no .tsx exists for it.

(QA gap, low priority) Steel theme accordion (theme-family-steel) did not expose its appearance-* children within a 1.5s wait this iteration — identical timing issue as iter78. Plain + Iron expand fine on first click. Consider making the family expansion synchronous or exposing a stable testID once children are mounted so test agents can reliably hit Steel skins.
critical_code_review_comments: /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/more.tsx is 1214 lines — still over the 700-line guideline (carried over from iter79). Recommend extracting the modals (change-password, home-rows, prefilled) and the THEME accordion into their own components.
data-management.tsx (345 lines) is clean and free of any legacy 'PREFILLED INFORMATION' / 'Delete the preloaded data instead' code paths — confirmed by both source grep and live DOM probe.

RemovePrefilledModal.tsx correctly exposes prefilled-choice / prefilled-keep / prefilled-everything testIDs and labels. The X close button and CANCEL action both dismiss correctly (verified by JS click in test).

Inventory free-limit banner (upgrade-banner / upgrade-banner-top) is gated on hiddenCount > 0; with blue@blue.com's 15 active items (= cap exactly), hidden_tool_count is 0 from the API and the banner stays hidden. Verified by checking body.innerText for 'Free plan' string — absent.

expo-router auto-discovery still seems to be holding a phantom /tbv-kit path even though no source file exists — see Metro error in action items. Worth a quick code audit for any string-literal route registration or PrefetchedRoutes list.
seed_data_creation: None — used existing blue@blue.com demo account (preloaded data intact). The 'Remove Everything' confirmation was explicitly NOT clicked, per main agent's instruction; only verified the choice modal opens.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Login on this preview: do NOT use the visible login form (slow to mount). Use POST /api/auth/login + localStorage.setItem('tt.auth.token', token) + localStorage.setItem('tt.auth.user', JSON.stringify(user)), then navigate to the target route directly via page.goto. blue@blue.com has 15 tools incl. 1 set ('Master Socket Set'). Tool-card testID pattern: tool-card-{uuid}. Tool detail tab testIDs: tab-details, tab-bundle (only on sets), tab-photos, tab-documents, tab-maintenance, tab-warranty, tab-history. Dealer card testID: dealer-card-{uuid}. Borrower row: borrower-row-{uuid}. Theme: theme-family-{plain,steel,iron} expands an accordion — wait 1.5s+ after clicking the family before querying appearance-* children (Steel may need longer than 1.5s; Plain + Iron work fast). The 'Remove Preloaded Data' row in /more is gated on demoPresent (api/me.demo_data flag); after a successful 'Remove Everything' the row disappears. Reports text 'Inventory'/'Insurance' confirms the report-type list renders. document.body.innerText returns a long 'ABC0123456789$.,' string from RN-Web's font-measurement layer — do NOT use innerText alone to detect content; rely on data-testid presence + getComputedStyle / specific element queries (e.g. querySelectorAll('div, span').map(textContent).join('|')).
rca_of_issue: No functional bugs. The Metro 'tbv-kit.tsx ENOENT' log noise is a stale-route artifact emitted by expo-router during the error-bundle SSR codepath; it does NOT block any user flow and produces no visible UI error. Likely traceable to either (a) a require.context match that's been baked into the dev bundle, or (b) a route literal kept in .expo/types/router.d.ts that the type-emitter regenerates on every start (the .d.ts is regenerated at boot but only adds new routes — old ones can persist). Recommend a full clean: `rm -rf /app/frontend/.expo /app/frontend/.metro-cache /app/frontend/node_modules/.cache && yarn install && sudo supervisorctl restart expo` and verify the log line disappears.
